before.scope: One-time inspection, not a universal density threshold. Several section introductions repeated their next detail page.

policy: Group related introduction, claim, support and limitation on a substantive topic page.
Retain community background, category definition, all three model implementations, comparable evidence, two demo introductions and enterprise adoption.
Keep setup commands, long raw tables, interface inventories and detailed experiment logs in the reading view or practice dialogs, not independent slides.
Keep uncertainty and negative evidence visible on each relevant slide; do not invent performance or quality advantages.
Keep original reading content, canonical anchors, controls and popup sources; presentation navigation never starts inference.

Each demo has its own live slide; intro links advance to it. Reuse original UI nodes, restore reading positions on exit, preserve settings and require manual Start. Support metrics collapse in presentation only so conversations remain visible.

validation.browser: Full 22-page Chinese and English traversal; screenshots reviewed for every page. All core desktop pages fit without scrolling at 1440x900. Narrow mobile traversal has no horizontal overflow; tall content can scroll. Reading content and disclosure state retained. Live controls/settings work in-place, inputs do not advance slides, Escape closes settings first, and original DOM identity and edited settings survive exit.
validation.unit: Outline/source anchors, bilingual substance and caveats, historical denominators and negative model-comparison findings checked.
validation.pptx_render: Initial curation: both languages exported to 20-slide PPTX and converted through LibreOffice to PDF/PNG; every rendered page reviewed in contact sheets with full-size spot checks.
validation.pptx_delivery_status: NOT visually accepted for Chinese: PDF conversion loses CJK text; English text survives but uses substituted font styling. This is a shared export/font-rendering issue, separate from browser page curation. Do not treat file generation as validated deliverability.
validation.live_demo_export_followup: The 22-slide English/dark PPTX was rendered and reviewed. The shared exporter omits the arena canvas and includes collapsed support descendants, producing overlap. These exports are not accepted as deliverables; use the browser for interactive presentation.

scope: Editorial presentation condensation of existing material, not new research results or global style changes. Browser deck accepted; export/font issue remains explicitly reported to shared workflow improvement.
